reason: I have a drawer full of half-used bottles and I compare price per day. $24.99 to $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and I would wait for a bigger coupon or flash sale instead of paying launch price.
objection: It costs more per day than what I already know, and I do not need another supplement I might quit after a week.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings the first box to about $19, so it costs the same per day as Toplux.
